title: GTA 6 made $3.79 billion in one day: it's official
yt_title: GTA 6 made $3.79 BILLION in one day… it's official 🤯
description:
It's official: Take-Two says GTA 6 made $3.79B in day-one retail sales worldwide (company estimate through Nov 19) and sold 32.5M copies before launch. That's nearly five times GTA 5's ~$800M first day (2013). Is the official number wrong because Sensor Tower estimated ~$2.36B? No: Sensor Tower only counted digital sales. Did you buy it on day one?

Sources: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261120446139/en/ https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/lets-put-gta-6s-usd3-79-billion-launch-in https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/
rumor_note: Estimate (not official): Sensor Tower's ~$2.36B covered digital sales only.
